name: PubMed Retrieval and Synthesis (PubMedRS-200)
description: PubMedRS-200 is a dataset of 200 medical questions and corresponding answers derived from published systematic reviews, designed to evaluate retrieval-augmented large language model systems in answering clinical questions based on scientific literature.
reputation: A small, specialized benchmark used in medical retrieval-augmented QA research, with limited but growing interest.
notes: Focuses on evaluating retrieval-augmented LLM systems for clinical question answering using scientific literature.
